title: cbam_goods_cn_codes
description: Customs codes used to measure EU-bound trade in CBAM goods. The schema's main job is keeping scope_status honest: the codes are currently HS2/HS4 aggregates standing in for the Annex I CN8 list, which is acceptable in development and not at publication.

scope_status.description: Two known states only. 01b_fetch_eu_trade.R warns loudly on the first and is silent on the second, so this value must never be a free-text edit.

exclusions_applied_in_query.description: Whether 01b_fetch_eu_trade.R actually SUBTRACTS the Annex I carve-outs when it queries Comext. Separate from scope_status on purpose: transcribing the exclusions and applying them are different jobs, and a list that names 7204 as excluded while the query still asks for all of chapter 72 is still an upper bound. 01b warns while this is false.

items.description: 2 to 8 digits. Usually HS2, HS4, HS6 or CN8 — an even number — but NOT always: Annex I writes one entry as '7202 2', a five-digit subheading group covering ferro-silicon. Storing that as '720220' or '72022x' would invent a code the Official Journal does not use, so the pattern admits odd lengths and the entry is kept exactly as printed.

exclusions.description: Codes Annex I explicitly carves OUT of a broader entry — chapter 72 minus the ferro-alloys and scrap, chapter 76 minus waste and kitchenware. Recorded even where the query cannot yet subtract them, because a carve-out that is not written down cannot later be applied.

gases.description: The greenhouse gases Annex I names for this sector. Aluminium is the only one carrying perfluorocarbons, and no PFC country package is published, so its exposure is knowingly an underestimate.

out_of_scope.description: Goods CBAM covers that this project does not. Recording them here is what keeps the 3-of-6 restriction a stated decision rather than an apparent oversight.
